sections.title: Ceramics
sections.intro: Functional and playful decorative pieces sculpted by hand. These pieces include everyday forms like mugs, shakers, and figures for humor, storytelling, and bold colors.

pieces.title: Fish with Legs
pieces.blurb: A bright orange fish with a long red tongue, denim jean shorts, and red sneakers. This piece was sculpted entirely out of clay and finished with glaze. It was inspired by the weird and unusual things that people dare to imagine in life.

pieces.title: Dragon Rainbow
pieces.blurb: A rainbow dragon that displays movement and an example of playful coloring. This piece was created with clay and finished with glaze. The inspiration behind this piece comes from the large colorful paper dragons that are displayed during Chinese New Year festivals.

pieces.title: Carousel
pieces.blurb: A pastel carousel with different animals as the seats. This piece features a light pink and yellow tent cover with yellow poles and a brown floor. The inside of this piece is hollow for the use of a light. There is a rabbit, racoon, sheep, fawn, polar bear and the entire carousel is topped with a capybara.

pieces.title: Salt & Pepper Shakers
pieces.subtitle: Baker’s Cart & Man
pieces.blurb: A salt and pepper shaker set featuring a plump baker man as the salt shaker and a bakery cart as the pepper shaker. The pie on a plate conveniently holds the pepper shaker and helps the baker man stand up. This piece was made entirely from clay and finished with glaze. The bakery cart features many different baked goods, a cash register, and a rolling station.

pieces.title: Pop Art Mug & Coaster
pieces.subtitle: Catbus
pieces.blurb:
A matching mug and matching coaster inspired by Catbus from the movie My Neighbor Totoro by Hayao Miyazaki. The mug displays Catbus running while the handle is the Catbus’ tail. The coaster displays a close up of the catbus’ face. This piece was constructed entirely out of clay and finished with glaze.
My Neighbor Totoro. Directed by Hayao Miyazaki, Studio Ghibli, 1988.

sections.title: Digital Art
sections.intro: Illustration, character design, and sequential art created digitally through procreate. Folklore, nature, and warmth run through work that ranges from single portraits to full comic pages.

pieces.title: The Season for Reading
pieces.blurb: An autumn day in your cozy bed with the smell of pumpkin candles surrounding the air. This image is supposed to capture those peaceful, warm, moments of staying indoors during the fall season with a good book. This image was drawn on procreate and features many wonderful graphic novels.

pieces.title: Lady of the Seals
pieces.blurb: A selkie surrounded by her many friends. This piece features an original character named Miss Seruki. Miss Seruki enjoys freeing lobsters and trapped wild life from restaurants. This piece’s idea comes from a strong love of seals and selkies stories alike.

pieces.title: A Playful Seal on the Beach
pieces.blurb: A laughing figure who is currently being ambushed with affection from a seal. This piece was created on procreate. The inspiration behind the piece comes from a love of seals and the playfulness that they bring to everyday life.

pieces.title: A Seal’s Kiss
pieces.blurb: A framed image of a figure under the water being kissed on the nose by a playful seal. This image displays a heart patterned border and bright golden hearts surrounding the characters. This piece was inspired by a strong love for seals and the wonderful sight of movement.

pieces.title: Something Familiar
pieces.blurb: A wandering traveler that stumbles upon a glowing butterfly. This piece features a girl with a butterfly tattoo, sword and long thick braided hair standing in the middle of a forest clearing. This piece was inspired by a love of butterfly back tattoos and the adventure one can find in the autumn forest. This was created on procreate and was an earlier piece that was focused on the idea of light and shadows.

pieces.title: The Sight of Celia
pieces.blurb: A girl with medieval themed clothes looking through the leaves while holding a golden flower. This piece displays an original character named Celia who is based in medieval times. This piece was created with procreate. The focus on this piece was the light effects of the sun on leaves.

pieces.title: The Huntress
pieces.blurb:
A strong woman leaping through the air holding a bow and arrow. This piece features colors associated with wilderness and outdoors. This character comes from an instagram OC Adopt Challenge created by the flesh_fairy_. The challenge directed the participants to create an outfit and pose for the original character while keeping the character's main features. 
LJ, [flesh_fairy_]. (2026, August 30). OC Adopt Challenge [Photo]. Instagram.

pieces.title: Want a Sunflower?
pieces.blurb: A shy centaur offering a bouquet of sunflowers in a glowy forest with the sight of the first snow. This piece features light greens and browns to make the main character pop against the background. This original character was inspired by storylike fantasies. This piece was created in procreate.

pieces.title: The Runaways
pieces.blurb: Two girls featured in the Victorian era running away from the police while comically stopping at a bakery to grab some baked goods during their great escape. This piece features two original characters named Rhiannon and Josephine that are a part of an even larger original comic book story. This piece was created with procreate.

pieces.title: You Are Enough
pieces.blurb: A LGBTQ+ art piece displaying people performing different types of everyday actions while wearing different LGBTQ+ flags. This piece was created for pride month in order to emphasize the loving community and everyone's connection within it. The art was created with procreate.

pieces.title: Pretty in Pink
pieces.blurb: A elf girl with strawberry blonde hair wearing a pink ballgown. This piece was created as a profile image for instagram. This art features bright colors and aspects that would be understood from far away on a smaller screen. This piece was created on procreate.

pieces.title: Golden Hour
pieces.blurb: A girl wearing a yellow top that matches the end highlights in her hair. The piece displays a study in rendering on what used to be flat colors. The art was created on procreate.
